Every registry milestone declares a real-world execution proof.
Closeout refuses incomplete, stale, mismatched, dirty or proof-free milestones.

The Forex T480 adapter remains catalog-locked, shared-core based, read-only, and exposes no arbitrary command, deployment mutation, MT5 API, market-data, account, or order surface.
Four isolated read-only Triad-plus-domain reviews, bound to the current commit, configuration, verifier, contract, and real-world evidence, produce a deterministic completion recommendation.
